research_scope: Smile Charge — Strike Super / cast-exclusive acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Compared the staged repository record with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, Android 17 (DB Super) customization documentation, and an independent Xenoverse 2 cast-exclusive skill list.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Smile Charge was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike; its cast-exclusive status is represented independently through usable_by_cac and the Unavailable for CaC taxonomy.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Smile Charge as a Strike Super Attack and lists 100 Ki.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Smile Charge is unavailable for CaCs. Android 17 has the skill in a preset, while Android 17 (DB Super) can receive it in Partner Customization after Customization Unlock Key 8 unlocks that partner; the skill is then purchased for the custom partner. Historical PQ/Official History associations are retained only as context and are not promoted as a current CaC route.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the skill is cast-exclusive and the reviewed sources do not establish an Ultimate Finish acquisition requirement for the skill itself.

records.name: Smile Charge
records.unlock_method: Cast-exclusive / Partner Customization (Android 17 (DB Super) after Customization Unlock Key 8)
records.source_quest_or_shop: Android 17 preset / Android 17 (DB Super) Partner Customization
records.skill_description: A mid-range grab rush in which Android 17 flies toward the opponent, grabs them, fires a Ki wave through them, and knocks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference characterizes Smile Charge as grab, rush, single-hit, mid-range, and knockback. The skill deals Strike-class damage despite using a Ki wave during the grab sequence. It is unavailable for CaCs.
records.acquisition_notes: Smile Charge is unavailable for CaCs. It is a native Android 17 skill and can be purchased for the customizable Android 17 (DB Super) partner after Customization Unlock Key 8 unlocks that partner. Historical PQ/Official History references are retained only as provenance context, not as a current Future Warrior acquisition route.
records.pve_notes: Cast-exclusive skill; no CaC acquisition route established and no Ultimate Finish requirement promoted.
records.pvp_notes: The move uses a grab-style rush and knockback sequence; exact frame and matchup behavior remains version-sensitive.
